newsitem.title: USA: Littlefield, Adams to sell shrs to new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Littlefield, Adams to sell shrs to new CEO.

text.p: Littlefield, Adams & Co said Monday it has a letter of intent to sell a 19.9 percent stake at $1.50 per share to Michael Blumenfield, who would become chief executive once the transaction closes.

As part of the deal, the company said it also will sell five-year warrant to purchase an additional 500,000 shares for $2 a share at a purchase price of $0.33 per warrant in exchange for $1 million in cash and a 15-month contingent note for $277,964.
Once the transaction closes, Blumenfield will be named chief executive and will have the right to appoint a majority of the members of Littlefield's board of directors, the company said.
Blumenfield would succeed David Simmonds as chief executive.
Chief Financial Officer Stanley Halbreich told Reuters that it has not yet been decided if Simmonds would retain his current positions of chairman and president.
Blumenfield was the founder and chief executive of BSN Sports and Sports Supply Group. Littlefield imprints and distributes athletic and leisure wear products.
